action_description: A 12-frame in-place jump. Keep frame 1 unchanged; frames 2-3 crouch, 4-6 ascend, frame 7 crosses the apex, 8-10 descend, frame 11 lands, and frame 12 recovers.
locked_constraints: jump vertically in place with no horizontal travel
land on the original ground line
preserve outfit, equipment, proportions, and palette
keep the full character inside the canvas
loop_constraint: The last frame must connect cleanly to frame 1 because the current game resource loops this animation.
